entries.content: Magic divides into eight schools (Destruction, Restoration, Illusion, Alteration, Thaumaturgy, Mysticism, Conjuration, Sorcery) that define spell effects.
Spell casting DCs by tier: Minor (DC 8), Apprentice (DC 11), Journeyman (DC 14), Expert (DC 17), Master (DC 20).
Casting requires rolling d20 + Intelligence modifier against the spell tier DC.
Sorcerer Spell Absorption chance equals (Intelligence + Willpower) / 2, capped at 75%. Nullifies incoming magic into Magicka.
The Spellmaker allows custom spell crafting, automatically assigning school, MP cost, and tier based on desired effect.
A natural 1 on casting causes a dangerous backfire, twisting the spell into localized recoil or unintended effects.
Mages gain advantage on spell casting checks.
Destruction magic unleashes direct elemental harm: fire, frost, or lightning.
Restoration magic mends wounds, restores attributes, and purges disease.

Soul gems store spiritual animus captured via Soul Trap to power enchantments and recharge magic items. White souls come from beasts (Petty to Grand). Black souls come from sentient mortals and require Black Soul Gems.

Mortal souls (Anuic animus) journey to Aetherius upon death unless trapped. Daedric vestiges reform in Oblivion. The Ideal Masters rule the Soul Cairn, trading necromantic power for harvested mortal souls.
